compiler.evidence: Migration/jclToZBuilder/samples/BLDMORT.jcl compiles EPSMPMT with STEPLIB IGY.V6R1M0.SIGYCOMP (Enterprise COBOL 6.1) and no PARM: the program's CBL NUMPROC(MIG) compiles as the default NUMPROC(NOPFD) (oracle_assumptions.md C5)

notes: IBM DBB MortgageApplication's CICS-LINKed front for the payment calculator: EPSCSMRT moves its COMMAREA into EPSPDATA, CALLs the program its table names (WS-CALLED-PROGRAM = EPSMPMT, a case `subprograms` entry: det-translated and run through handleCall, #4803), and copies the payment, the error text and a return code (0, or 8 when the text is not spaces) back. Its scenarios are the VALIDATION paths (principal not > 0, over 100000000.01, rate not > 0: EPSMPMT's A999 returns before the annuity formula) and one 30-year payment (payment-30-years, #6072), which runs EPSMPMT's annuity formula and its IEEE binary64 `**` (line 125, oracle_assumptions.md C6) and takes the RETURN-ERROR = SPACES arm. The dead FUNCTION ANNUITY (line 144) is never reached.

scenarios.name: principal-zero
scenarios.why: principal not > 0: EPSMPMT's error 1, RETCODE 8, the payment left as EPSCSMRT zeroed it

scenarios.name: principal-negative
scenarios.why: a negative principal: error 1 text 'PRINCIPLE AMOUNT IS NEGATIVE'

scenarios.name: payment-30-years
scenarios.why: a valid 30-year loan: EPSMPMT returns a payment and no error text, so EPSPDATA-RETURN-ERROR = SPACES is true and RETCODE is 0 (the payment itself runs EPSMPMT's binary64 `**`, oracle_assumptions.md C6, the same inputs as mortgage-mpmt thirty-years)
